The oldest open claim is [00002047](/lightning/r/500aj00003jKc9bAAC/view) for [Tamarack Outfitters](/lightning/r/001aj000040t1o6AAA/view). It was reported on 23 Aug, so it has been open **40 days**.

- **What happened:** A storefront window was smashed and merchandise was taken.
- **Status:** Payment Issued, but the claim isn't closed yet.

I counted from the reported date, not the record's created date, because the created date only shows when the data was loaded. Next oldest are [00002053](/lightning/r/500aj00003jKc9hAAC/view) and [00002064](/lightning/r/500aj00003jKc9sAAC/view), both reported on 29 Aug (**34 days**) and both also at Payment Issued.
